summary: Source Workbench security history validates complete responses, retains known same-filter records on failure, and distinguishes pending/unavailable from authoritative empty history. Filter changes invalidate prior requests before paint; same-scope overlapping successes and failures cannot overwrite newer records or warnings. Fourteen real Chromium controls use the actual React client with isolated mocked services; twenty-one added unit controls reject malformed success and preserve extensible fields without copies or automatic retries. Explicit GUI/PWDT refresh is read-only. Installed WebViews, remote runtime outages, scale and physical correctness remain separate.

required_text: Keep the last validated history for this scope
accepts authoritative empty history and extensible event fields without copying
preserves the original unavailable error without retrying
read failure must not erase known audit history
first-read failure is unavailable, not an authoritative empty history
pending filtered history never masquerades as empty or reuses old facets
filter failure never shows records from the previous scope
